expanded_count_warning: 192 is the sum of explicitly scoped typical applications, including shared-reference occurrences. It is NOT unique hardware, wired I/O, installed controller terminals or a procurement total. Four MPAC-relief AI-1 occurrences refer to the already counted FC-3 temperature source. Condenser-water and EF-6 owner_groups in points.json retain source ownership, including the MPAC status conflict; valve aliases and generator_damper_mapping refine service without adding points.
